sc: A handwritten book is a book obtained during The Prisoner of Glouphrie quest and used in Bolrie's lab when building an anti-illusion device.
This book can be found in the bookcase of a Player-owned house after completing the quest.

A mis-fortune from The Mighty Zoltan (9/.x: A mis-fortune from The Mighty Zoltan (9/17) is one of the 17 mis-fortunes granted by The Mighty Zoltan at the Spring Fayre.

sc: The Agility lamp is a reward lamp obtained after completion of The Light Within.
Arcane Apprentice Top (Alternative) is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked through the Potion Pandemonium promotion on Treasure Hunter.
Archleather coif is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Crafting skill.
The augmented attuned crystal orb is a level 80 Magic off-hand weapon created by using an augmentor on an attuned crystal orb.
An augmented Deathwarden robe bottom is an item created by using an augmentor on an unaugmented tier 90 deathwarden robe bottom, or by upgrading an augmented tier 80 deathwarden robe bottom.
The blood-dyed augmented Imperium core is a level 92 Magic weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Imperium core (blood), or by using blood dye on an augmented imperium core.
Additionally, it can be made by dyeing an undyed version or upgrading a non-elite version.
Avantoe gloves are a reward that can be purchased with 100 Fist of Guthix tokens from the Fist of Guthix minigame or from Stanley Limelight for 80 thaler.
They can be obtained at level 68 Hunter by catching azure skillchompas at the very north of the Rellekka Hunter area.
Bandos page 4 is an item which can be added to the damaged Bandos book received from Jossik after the Horror from the Deep quest.
It can be found as a reward from all difficulties of Treasure Trails or by burning vyre corpses in the columbarium.
It is obtained from a rotten barrel while constructing the sled, and is used to provide skis for the sled.
The bathus full helm is an item that can only be obtained and equipped while Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Smithing skill.
The black defender is a defender obtained in the Warriors' Guild, and is held in the off-hand in place of a shield.
It is dropped by Cyclopes on the top floor of the Warriors' Guild, but only if the player is wielding or carrying a steel defender.
It is made through the Herblore at level 25 by mixing blamish snail slime with a harralander potion (unfinished).
The blamish oil is also rarely dropped by citizens of Canifis when using a wolfbane dagger, after completion of Heroes' Quest.
Bob's collar is a collar obtained from Bob the cat during the quest Ritual of the Mahjarrat.
Bone bolts can be bought from the Nardok's Bone Weapons shop, run by Nardok in the Dorgeshuun Mines, after completing The Lost Tribe quest.
Bone bolts cannot be created by players.
Candyfloss was an item that was obtainable from the Squeal of Fortune throughout the summer months as a common prize.
The chocatrice cape was the reward for completing the 2008 Easter event.
The chocolate egg was a reward from the 2008 Easter event.
Up to three eggs could be obtained, after eight, six, and four chunks of chocolate, respectively.
Chocolate eggs are not to be confused with easter eggs, which were obtained during the 2002 Easter event.
A Christmas wrapping paper booster is an item that can rarely be found by skilling during the 2024 Christmas event.
It can be obtained at the same time as Christmas wrapping paper is received.
Clue scroll (easy) is an emote clue obtained from easy sealed clue scrolls.
Clue scroll (medium) is a coordinate clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
Smithing the gloves requires level 38 Smithing, and they can be made with one cosmic bar on the workbench on level 1 of the Elemental Workshop.
One can be obtained by milking the undead dairy cow in Alice's farm west of the Ectofuntus whilst having an empty bucket in the backpack before having received the cake.
The Daemonheim aura 4 was a reward for completing all of the Daemonheim achievements, including elite, and was given by Thok.
Dark arrowheads are items that can be obtained by killing dark beasts, which requires a Slayer level of 90 or above to kill.
They can be fletched into dark arrows at level 70 Fletching when used with headless arrows, which are made by using arrow shafts with feathers, granting 262.
The Devout Yak scroll (Ethereal Storage scroll) was an item obtained by selecting the Devout relic in the Equilibrium League.

Despite the scroll functioning as stated when using the yak's special ability, the action of repeating the last unnote operation was available as the yak's default left-click option whether the scroll was in the inventory or not.

They are made by dyeing a pair of elite sirenic chaps with a Third Age dye.

An empty pot is obtained by using a pot of flour to make bread on Tutorial Island.

sc: It is part of the first tower robe armour, a reward for the completion of Rune Memories.

Forge Goblin Frog.x: The Forge Goblin Frog is a companion pet that is unlocked as part of the Forge Goblin Pack. It could originally be unlocked by purchasing the RuneScape Max Pack through Steam.

sc: The fragile divination urn (empty) is an urn created by using a mind rune on a fragile divination urn (no rune).
It was made by combining a focus sight, hexcrest and slayer helmet (which had to be uncharged beforehand) by using one on any of the others.
The helm could hold a maximum of 20 ferocious ring charges and 40 ring of slaying charges, made by using the rings on the helmet and requiring 60 Crafting.
Furniture plans: Vault door are furniture plans obtainable via safecracking.
A gold amulet is made by using a gold bar on a furnace with an amulet mould.
Golden cavefish eggs are a reward from Fishing, fishing cavefish, used in the Aquarium of a player-owned house.
As a rare reward from fishing cavefish (level 85 Fishing required) -- approximately 3 hours on average to get the egg.
Golden Zamorak godsword is a two-handed melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased for 1 golden cosmetic token from the Golden Goods shop.
Grave creeper shortbow (unstrung) is an item that can only be obtained and used while in Daemonheim.
It is made by using a knife (in the inventory or tool belt) on Grave creeper branches.
Once activated the idol was consumed and awarded bonus experience in the following skills: Cooking, Firemaking, Hunter, Slayer, Strength, Divination.

tx:
Mauling Vorago is required for the following:
• Mauling all six rotations in normal mode will grant the player the ability to create a hard mode instance for Vorago.
• In hard mode:
• Mauling each rotation will grant the player one piece of the Omens cosmetic override set if not already owned.
• Mauling all six rotations in hard mode will grant the player the chance to obtain an ancient artefact, an item that unlocks the Bombi pet.
• Mauling any rotation unlocks 'The Defeater' title.
• Mauling every rotation unlocks the bronze variant of 'The Defeater' title.
• Mauling every rotation in a team of two or fewer unlocks the silver variant of 'The Defeater' title.
• Mauling every rotation solo unlocks the gold variant of 'The Defeater' title.
• Mauling Vorago at least once in either mode is a requirement for the trimmed completionist cape.

Musketeer's tabard (orange).x: The orange musketeer's tabard is part of the musketeer outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

Necturion Platelegs.x: The Necturion Platelegs are a legs slot cosmetic override that is part of the Necturion Outfit. Along with the rest of the outfit, they can be unlocked by spending 100% respect in the Artisans' Workshop.

sc: The Nightblood ring is a ring dropped by Ravenous Strigoi in Shuruk-Ba.
The outfit has also been available in the H'oddments Store.
It is made by using a Summoning pouch on a Summoning obelisk with 195 spirit shards, a blue charm, and an obsidian charm in the backpack, requiring 73 Summoning and giving 642.
It can be made into ten Obsidian Golem scrolls (Volcanic Strength) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 7.

sc: The strange compass is created by combining all four compass pieces from the 2015 RuneScape Road Trip.
The superior scrimshaw of magic is an item that can be made within a player-owned port workshop once all 4 scroll pieces of the scrimshaw have been obtained.
The supreme defence potion is a combination potion that can be made at level 93 Herblore after unlocking the recipe.
It is made by combining a super defence (4) and an extreme defence (4) in a crystal flask, giving 292.
A teak dresser flatpack can be made at a workbench (Steel framed bench or better) in the workshop of a player-owned house.
The team-23 cape is a wilderness cape that can be purchased for 50 coins from Larry.
While it is seen on the reward scroll, it cannot actually be obtained by players.
It can be created by combining 3,600 shark fragments.
They can be traded, but only for other parts.
It is obtained from Captain Braindeath and used to force the zombie head to tell the player where the barrelchest factory is.
The undead dragonhide vambraces are a part of undead dragonhide armour, made by crafting a piece of undead dragon leather at 75 Crafting, giving 102 experience.
It was made by using 2 chocolate bars, and gnome spice with a half baked crunchy, then baking it.
The unhallowed robe skirt could be bought for 25 ectoplasm from Brother Heinous during the 2012 Halloween event.
A warped stone can be received as a drop from bosses on the warped Dungeoneering floors 48 to 60.

Warrior of Het gloves.x: The Warrior of Het gloves are a hands slot cosmetic override that can be obtained randomly while skilling in Het's Oasis. They were originally unlocked through the Oasis Restoration event.

sc: These hats are dropped by spellwisps at the Wizards' Tower and also by Imps.
The hats can be purchased at Betty's Magic Emporium in Port Sarim and one can be acquired in the quest Wanted!.
Wrapped oomlies are raw food made by combining a raw oomlie and a palm leaf, which can be cooked at level 50 Cooking to get a cooked oomlie wrap.

Wushanko Top (override).x: The Wushanko Top is a torso slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Wushanko outfit. It is the override equivalent of the Wushanko jacket and Wushanko top items.
